summary.text: Adam Presa is a Republican state representative from New Hampshire House District Hillsborough 12 who has served in the New Hampshire House of Representatives since 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Adam Presa earned a bachelor's degree from New England College in 2024 and a graduate degree from New England College in 2025, according to Ballotpedia.
His career experience includes working as a realtor.
He first took office representing Hillsborough 12 on December 4, 2024.
